claim: In the Amazon Quick plan comparison table for organizations (sign up with an AWS account), the Professional plan costs $20 per user per month and the Enterprise plan costs $40 per user per month, with pooled index storage of 25 GB per user for Professional and 50 GB per user for Enterprise.
question: Amazon Quick pricing: what do the Professional and Enterprise plans cost per user?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon Quick Professional and Enterprise plans, per user per month, plus the $250 per account per month infrastructure fee
qualifiers.condition: Plan prices are in the table header; see quick-pricing-infrastructure-fee-250 for the account fee.
